mainEntity.name: How much does commercial freezer repair cost in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most commercial freezer repairs cost $200 to $900, plus a call-out fee of about $100 to $250. Compressors cost $450 to $1,100 or more depending on the unit. You get a fixed quote before we start, and that is the price you pay.

mainEntity.name: Why is my commercial freezer not freezing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The common causes are a dirty or blocked condenser, a failed fan, ice blocking the evaporator because the defrost system has failed, a worn door seal, a faulty controller or probe, or low refrigerant from a leak. A technician tests each one in turn.

mainEntity.name: Why is my commercial freezer covered in ice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Heavy frost usually means the door is not sealing, the defrost heater, timer or sensor has failed, or the drain is blocked. Chipping the ice off only helps for a short time. We find why it formed and fix that part.

mainEntity.name: What temperature should a commercial freezer be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frozen food should stay frozen hard, and most commercial freezers are set around -18°C. If your freezer is running warmer and food is going soft, book a repair and keep the door closed.

mainEntity.name: My freezer has stopped. Should I throw out the food?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep the door shut so the cold stays in. If the food still has ice crystals and is hard, it is usually fine once the freezer is back. Food that has thawed and sat above 5°C for more than 4 hours should be thrown out and not refrozen.
